title: Reaction Debugger can throw NullReferenceException when opened before override state initialization
symptom: Opening Reaction Debugger can crash its refresh path with NullReferenceException.
trigger: Open Reaction Debugger before the delayed OnEnable initialization has populated property and menu override state.
root_cause: OpenDebugger refreshes the UI before delayed initialization, leaving ForcePropertyOverrides or the override dictionaries null when ResolveToggleInitialStates runs.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the fix that initializes empty override dictionaries during RefreshUI and tolerates a null ForcePropertyOverrides dictionary.

title: Blendshape Sync curves can be set incorrectly when migrating from older Modular Avatar versions
symptom: Blendshape Sync remap curves can become incorrect after migrating a component created by an older Modular Avatar version.
trigger: Open or migrate Blendshape Sync data created before the remap-curve validity field existed.
root_cause: Legacy bindings had no explicit validity marker, so migration could treat an uninitialized serialized curve as a valid remap curve instead of initializing the identity 0-to-100 mapping.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the RemapCurveIsValid migration fix, which initializes legacy bindings to a linear 0-to-100 curve before use.

title: Blendshape Sync preview stops processing later bindings when one target mesh is missing
symptom: If one Blendshape Sync binding points to a missing target mesh, valid bindings after it stop updating in the editor preview.
trigger: Preview a Blendshape Sync component whose internal binding list contains a null or destroyed TargetMesh before later valid bindings.
root_cause: EditorUpdate returned from the entire binding loop when TargetMesh was null instead of skipping only the invalid binding.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the preview fix that continues past null TargetMesh bindings.

title: Reactive IsConstantActive analysis is wrong for inverted constant conditions
symptom: A constant Reactive rule with an inverted condition can be classified as active when it should be inactive.
trigger: Analyze a constant reaction rule whose condition is inverted.
root_cause: InitiallyActive already includes inversion, but IsConstantActive XORed Inverted a second time because of the old expression, reversing the result again.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the corrected IsConstantActive calculation that uses the already-inverted InitiallyActive value directly.

title: Merge Armature MapBone can throw when merge targets or intermediate bones are missing
symptom: Merge Armature bone mapping can throw NullReferenceException instead of reporting an unmappable bone when the merge target is unset or a target path segment is missing.
trigger: Map a child bone through a Merge Armature whose mergeTarget is unset or whose corresponding target hierarchy lacks an intermediate bone.
root_cause: MapBone dereferenced mergeTarget.Get(this) and continued calling Transform.Find after a prior Find had returned null.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the MapBone null checks, which returns null when the merge target or an intermediate target transform cannot be found.

title: Visible Head Accessory mesh retargeting can calculate bindposes incorrectly
symptom: Visible Head Accessory can produce incorrectly processed skinned mesh data when retargeting mixed visible and non-visible bone weights.
trigger: Process a Visible Head Accessory mesh whose primitives mix vertices weighted to visible and non-visible bones and therefore require proxy-bone retargeting.
root_cause: The previous mesh-retarget path used incorrect bindpose handling while remapping affected bone weights; the maintainer fix replaces that path with explicit vertex cloning, bone remapping, and corrected bindpose generation.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the Visible Head Accessory mesh/bindpose processing fix.

title: The avatar's original first FX layer can be disabled in MMD worlds after Modular Avatar inserts layers before it
component: Modular Avatar MMD FX layer handling
symptom: In MMD worlds, the avatar's original first FX layer can be disabled after Reactive Components or merged layers displace it from layer index zero.
trigger: Insert one or more Modular Avatar layers before the avatar's original first FX layer, then use the avatar in an MMD world.
root_cause: MMD relay logic treated the displaced original first layer as one of the layers MMD mode could disable, even though an unprocessed avatar's first FX layer is effectively pinned on and cannot be disabled by the MMD world.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the MMD relay fix that tracks the original first FX layer and excludes it from implicit MMD disabling unless explicitly opted in.

title: Importing Modular Avatar into a VRChat World project can cause compilation errors
symptom: A VRChat World project can fail to compile after Modular Avatar is imported.
trigger: Import Modular Avatar into a project that has the VRChat base/world packages but not the avatars package.
root_cause: The harmony-patches assembly defined MA_VRCSDK3_AVATARS based on com.vrchat.base, which is also present in World projects; the fix keys the version define to com.vrchat.avatars instead.
solution: Use a Modular Avatar build containing the corrected harmony-patches asmdef versionDefines entry for com.vrchat.avatars.
